nodes.label: smartglass_co2.csv dataset (1000 rows, seed 42)

nodes.label: Hybrid Persistence Architecture (MySQL + MongoDB)
nodes.rationale: Separates transactional structured data (MySQL/JPA) from flexible catalog documents (MongoDB) to fit storage to data shape.

nodes.label: masa_kg target leakage exclusion
nodes.rationale: masa_kg is computed from the same formula as co2_kg, so including it would leak the target and inflate metrics (earlier MAE 20.69/R2 0.9461 discarded).

nodes.label: Predictive model integration (next phase, US-09/US-13)

nodes.label: Barra flotante del comparador

nodes.norm_label: huella y compensacion de carbono del pedido
nodes.rationale: F24: absolute order CO2e is shown neutral (traffic-light color only for intensity). Optional offset checkbox (+$5.000, Premium).

nodes.label: checkout.html (Finalizar compra)
nodes.rationale: Distraction-free checkout: own header with brand, progress steps and exit to cart instead of the public navbar. Form posts to /checkout/procesar with direccionEnvio, ciudad, telefono, metodoPago (TARJETA_CREDITO/PSE), compensarCarbono. T2: shows error message when order could not be created (e.g. insufficient stock).

nodes.label: numero(txt)
nodes.rationale: Parses prices in es-CO (1.234,56) or en (1,234.56) format.

nodes.label: unicoMejor(valores, mayorEsMejor)
nodes.rationale: Returns the index of a single best value, or -1 if tied or fewer than 2 valid values, so 'Mejor precio'/'Mejor calificacion' chips are only shown for a unique winner.

nodes.label: destacados.html (Galeria de destacados)
nodes.rationale: Editorial gallery: first piece spans double. F18: products without photo show small isotype on stage instead of a broken image.

nodes.label: Formulario de resena (calificacion y comentario)
nodes.rationale: Only for logged users; posts to /detalle/{id}/resenas; radios in reverse order so CSS can light stars 'up to here'.

nodes.label: Script galeria de miniaturas del detalle
nodes.norm_label: script galeria de miniaturas del detalle

nodes.label: detalle.html (Ficha de producto)
nodes.rationale: Shows price/state via comercio fragments, real stock (D1) and offer end date; quantity max capped by controlled stock; sold-out shows explicit message + disabled button. T1 (D4): visitor buys without account, login at payment. Separate spec sheets for flat glass and sculptures.

nodes.label: factura.html (Factura de venta)
nodes.rationale: Invoice is a document: always drawn as a light sheet even in dark mode and printed as-is (A4 print styles). Shows pedido.numeroFactura, detalles, totals and estimated carbon footprint (F24 neutral color).

nodes.label: auth-visual :: panel (Evolucion del vidrio)
nodes.rationale: Left panel of login/registro illustrating glass manufacturing in 5 stages (materia prima, fusion, flotado sobre estano, templado, tu pieza). Placed after <main> in HTML so keyboard reaches the form first; CSS moves it left. Without JS shows stage 5; with prefers-reduced-motion or photosensitive mode it does not auto-advance. Purely illustrative, does not touch contract calculations.

nodes.label: comercio :: estado(p) badges
nodes.rationale: T2 shared commercial-state badges (Agotado / Oferta / Ultimas unidades). Each state carries text + icon (never color only) and is not animated, so it respects photosensitive mode. D1: 'Ultimas unidades' and 'Agotado' come from real stock (CatalogoProducto.stock).

nodes.label: comercio :: precio(p, clase)
nodes.rationale: With a valid offer shows list price struck through (<del>) and offer price (<ins>) with screen-reader text 'Antes/Ahora'. D2: figures always use es-CO separators in all languages.

nodes.label: navbar-publico :: navbar-publico
nodes.rationale: Public and account navbar. Visitors see Inicio, Tienda, Vidrio personalizado, Acerca de, Iniciar sesion; everyone sees the cart (T1: visitor buys without account and logs in at payment). Logged users get 'Mi cuenta' menu; admins also the admin panel link. main.js marks active page, controls menus and fills .subnav. data-tour attributes are the targets of the guided tour.

nodes.label: Panel de accesibilidad (daltonismo / fotosensible)
nodes.rationale: T1 accessibility toggles data-a11y-modo daltotonico and fotosensible, wired by main.js inicializarAccesibilidad; available to visitors too.

nodes.label: Selector de idioma (es-CO / es-ES / en)
nodes.rationale: T0 i18n: ?lang= links work without JS; main.js also saves the choice in the account. Prices always shown in Colombian format.

nodes.label: notificaciones :: campana
nodes.rationale: T3 notification bell for public and admin bars. Filled by main.js inicializarNotificaciones via GET /api/notificaciones every 60 s (polling, no WebSocket), paused when tab hidden. Unread count in aria-label and visible number (not just a colored dot); sections for active offers and best sellers. Texts resolved server-side in active language.

nodes.label: recursos :: recursos (head comun)
nodes.rationale: Common <head> resources: theme-init.js and a11y-init.js load first and synchronously to apply theme/a11y before paint; exposes window.SG_LANG and SG_TXT for main.js i18n; fonts Bricolage Grotesque + Geist; Phosphor icons pinned at 2.1.1; theme.css.

nodes.label: window.SG_TXT / SG_LANG (textos JS traducidos)
nodes.rationale: T0 i18n: translated strings for main.js from the same messages*.properties as the views. Rule D2: no contract numbers here.

nodes.label: window.sgT(clave, respaldo, args)
nodes.rationale: Translation helper for per-page scripts that run before main.js; fills {n} placeholders.

nodes.label: tour :: tour (template sg-tour-datos)
nodes.rationale: T4 guided tour data. main.js inicializarTour shows it first time (localStorage 'sg-tour-visto') or with ?tour=1 / [data-tour-iniciar]. Each step highlights the navbar element with matching data-tour (tienda, disenar, carrito, cuenta, ajustes); if hidden (mobile menu closed) step shows without highlight. Inert <template>.

nodes.label: guia.html (Guia de compra)
nodes.rationale: T4: static, no-JS version of the guided tour; reuses tour.p*_texto messages and offers a [data-tour-iniciar] button to start the tour.
